category_title: Six-year-old girl with PDD-NOS exhibiting behavioral obsessions and communication delays
minimal_context: The student is responding to teacher instructions during a class observation while the teacher holds a reinforcer.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Touch the picture of the cat.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Touches the picture correctly and looks expectantly at the teacher's hand holding the reinforcer.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay. Now touch the picture of the dog.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to finish this first.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Give! (Starts crying, tries to snatch the reinforcer from the teacher's hand, and hits the teacher's arm when it is not provided instantly.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Touch the picture of the cat.

STUDENT: (Touches the picture correctly and looks expectantly at the teacher's hand holding the reinforcer.)

TUTOR: Okay. Now touch the picture of the dog.

STUDENT: I want.

TUTOR: We need to finish this first.

STUDENT: Give! (Starts crying, tries to snatch the reinforcer from the teacher's hand, and hits the teacher's arm when it is not provided instantly.)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: as the teacher was late to provide the reinforcer
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: wanted to take the reinforcer from the teacher and hit the teacher

behavior_patterns.condition: when something she wants does not occur instantly
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: expressing her desires through inappropriate ways such as crying and hitting
